**r01:** False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is a pure in-memory implementation using `sync.Map` with TTL-based expiration, defined in `store/cache/cache.go`. No external cache service is used.

**r02:** False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. No rate-limiting or throttling code exists anywhere in the codebase.

**r03:** False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. The `internal/scheduler/` package exists with a fully implemented cron scheduler, but it is never imported or used by any production code — it is dead/unused infrastructure.

**r04:** False premise. There is no message broker (neither NATS nor RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery uses a simple in-process buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128) in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, drained by 4 goroutine workers initialized in `init()` at line 42. No external queue or broker is involved.

**r05:** False premise. There is no GraphQL schema. The public API is gRPC + gRPC-Gateway (REST), defined via Protocol Buffers in `proto/`. The server also exposes a Connect RPC surface (generated in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/`).
